title: disa cephalotes subsp. frigida
intro: Disa cephalotes subsp. frigida, commonly known as the Cape Disa, is a species of orchid found in the Western Cape province of South Africa. It is a terrestrial orchid that grows in the fynbos ecosystem and has been used in traditional medicine for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Disa cephalotes subsp. frigida include its potential to treat various ailments such as fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues, while its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
